build: Modwerk's linker: the released core-ar2 0.3 (6b97dfb3…3e58) + this folder's compiled Pipo Loop 0.1.0-experimental, materialised against the owner's stock OS 1.74, --version PP03

emulator.name: rytm-emu
emulator.settings: card image with one generated sample, JIT on

conditions: SETUP (cold boot on a card holding a generated 0.5 s rising ramp, RAMP.wav, added with dtcard): dtboot pp03.syx --card card.img --instr 14800M --every 1000M --press NO@2000M --press NO@2300M --press NO@2600M --press NO@2900M --press GLOBAL@3300M --press DOWN@5100M --press YES@5400M --press DOWN@5700M --press YES@6000M --press DOWN@6300M --press YES@6600M --press DOWN@6900M --press YES@7200M --press RIGHT@7500M --press DOWN@7800M --press DOWN@8100M --press YES@8400M --press YES@8700M --press NO@10100M --press NO@10300M --press NO@10500M --press NO@10700M --press SMPL@11000M --turn 3:6@11300Mx6/30M --press YES@11700M --turn 6:6@12500Mx6/30M --save setup.snap (BD: SMP 1, LOP ON, SAMPLE page). Each capture then resumes setup.snap. A turn of +8 raw counts is one detent; stock's encoder hysteresis drops the first detents after the setup's turns, so more turns are sent than values. Frames are dtboot's firmware-rendered 128x64 screen at 3x, unmodified.
